sections.label: Limits
sections.description: Caps on how much can be given. A kit marked "limits": false (playtest gear) is exempt, and logged either way.

sections.label: Kits
sections.description: Size limits for random kits. A catalog that goes past them loses those tables, with a warning in the log.

sections.label: Server presents
sections.description: Which mods may give gifts from the server (rewards, quest prizes). Off by default.

GiverDailyCap.label: Gifts per giver per day
GiverDailyCap.description: How many gifts one person may give in a day. 0: no limit. Server presents don't count.

RecipientDailyCap.label: Gifts per player per day
RecipientDailyCap.description: How many gifts one player may receive in a day, from anyone. 0: no limit.

PairCooldownSeconds.label: Wait between gifts to the same player (seconds)
PairCooldownSeconds.description: The least time between two gifts from the same giver to the same player. 0: none.

AnonymousGivers.label: Hide who gave it
AnonymousGivers.description: Recipients read "An operator sent you..." instead of the giver's name. The gift log always keeps the real name.

Announce.label: Announce gifts
Announce.description: Tell everyone online about each gift.

MaxDepth.label: Deepest table nesting
MaxDepth.description: How many random tables may sit inside each other.

MaxItemsPerRoll.label: Most items in one roll
MaxItemsPerRoll.description: The most items one random kit may give at once, counted one by one.

TrustedMods.Hledjolf:PlaytestGamified.Tr.label: PlaytestGamified may give presents
TrustedMods.Hledjolf:PlaytestGamified.Tr.description: Lets PlaytestGamified give its rewards from the server: its own kits, Generous Operator's and the server's, up to the power below. Off: it can't give anything from the server.

TrustedMods.Hledjolf:PlaytestGamified.Ma.label: PlaytestGamified: most powerful
TrustedMods.Hledjolf:PlaytestGamified.Ma.description: The strongest present it may give, rated on the kit's best roll: the earliest world zone where its strongest item can be had (1 to 4). 0: only kits with no rated items.

TrustedMods.Hledjolf:PlaytestGamified.Un.label: PlaytestGamified: unrated kits
TrustedMods.Hledjolf:PlaytestGamified.Un.description: Also lets it give its own kits that the power curve can't rate (modded items, for now), whatever their power.
